lines.name: Paid Acquisition Launch
lines.description: One offer, one country and one advertising platform: Meta or Google. Includes up to three campaigns, six ad variants using client materials, conversion measurement and 30 days of monitoring and optimization from campaign activation. Includes a closing report. Advertising spend is separate; results are not guaranteed.
